column1: # The mission-control tier's guard fixture rows: each act the
# `mission-control` tier of scripts/policy-guard.sh refuses or lets through,
#   expect   deny, ask (the operator's answer decides), or defer (the guard
#            stays silent and the call reaches the permission layer)
#   surface  bash: <input> is the command; file: <input> is `<tool> <path>`
#            for an Edit, Write, MultiEdit or NotebookEdit payload; mcp:
#            <input> is the update_pull_request tool_input as JSON
#   knob     `-` for the harness defaults, else one machine-local line
#   reason   an ERE the refusal's reason matches (`-` on a defer row); the
#            rewrite, protected-push and remote-delete rows spelled through
#            git meet the blanket git-mutation refusal, and their reason
# @UNIT@ is the harness's unit clone, @SCRATCH@ a directory in no repository
# and @HOME@ a fixture home outside both.
